composition: Lausanne Cathedral on the Cité hill above the old town and Lake Geneva · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Lausanne Cathedral crowns the Cité hill, a Gothic church with flying buttresses and a single completed belfry above the old-town roofs. The west front was planned with two towers, and only the belfry was finished, so the skyline is not a twin-tower facade. Lake Geneva lies beyond the roofs. The painted portal is not shown close up, and Chillon is a separate Montreux scene. No scaffolding is added. The Open-Meteo model sets the light.
